title: Hontiveros urges Senate colleagues to resume deliberations on Anti-Political Dynasty bill
summary: The Senate on Wednesday assured it will resume consideration of the pending Anti-Political Dynasty bill after the Supreme Court directed Congress to enact an Anti-Political Dynasty law.
